vocabulary.example: There is a board on the wall.
The bag is under the desk.
How many pencils do you have?

grammar.point: There is / There are + countable & uncountable nouns
grammar.point_ko: There is / There are + 셀 수 있는/없는 명사
grammar.explanation_en: Use 'There is' with singular or uncountable nouns (There is a book / There is some paper), and 'There are' with plural nouns (There are two pens). Uncountable nouns like 'paper' never take a plural -s.
grammar.explanation_ko: 단수 명사나 셀 수 없는 명사에는 'There is'(There is a book / There is some paper), 복수 명사에는 'There are'(There are two pens)를 씁니다. 'paper' 같은 셀 수 없는 명사는 절대 복수형 -s를 붙이지 않습니다.

examples.en: There are ten desks in the room.
There is some paper on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Excuse me, is there a pencil I can borrow?
dialogue.line_ko: 실례합니다, 빌릴 수 있는 연필이 있나요?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, there are some pencils in my bag.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 제 가방에 연필이 좀 있어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Thank you. How many notebooks do you have?

reading.title: My Classroom
reading.text: There are twenty desks in my classroom. There is a big board at the front. On my desk, there are two pens, a pencil, and some paper. There is also a small bag under my chair. I like my classroom.
reading.text_ko: 제 교실에는 책상이 스무 개 있어요. 앞쪽에는 큰 칠판이 있어요. 제 책상 위에는 펜 두 개, 연필 하나, 그리고 종이가 좀 있어요. 의자 아래에는 작은 가방도 있어요. 저는 제 교실이 좋아요.

explanation.en: The text says 'There are twenty desks in my classroom.'
The text says 'There is a big board at the front.'
The text says 'There is also a small bag under my chair.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'a small bag under my chair'라고 나옵니다.
